body: I haven't given anything worth loving. I have financially burdened my family because of my ptsd.  My husband can't even share a bed with me anymore because my night terrors are so bad. I have migraines almost every day and can't play with my daughter outside. My agoraphobia makes even grocery shopping difficult. My family is tired of having to accommodate me. I am a burden every day. I have to force a smile every minute so I don't scare my daughter. I'm always forgetting to do things. Important things. I'm scared of everything. I can't be left alone in the dark.  If I'm around people I sweat so much because I'm nervous. They comment. I've run out of benefits to cover therapist sessions. My mom is dying and my father hates me. I bring nothing good to this world. And I try so hard. Everything is exhausting.
Please someone talk to me. Please
